Research should distinguish delivery, observation, owner acknowledgement, and completion of the requested action, and evaluate escalation against existing mechanisms.

verdicts.note: The count of 65 notification-like user records is not a verified count of 65 independent wake triggers; transcript record shape can include other background notifications. Error responses stop at 22:07Z in the checked interval, so until-reset repetition is not established. The later result is positive observation evidence for wake 419, not completion evidence for its underlying action and not proof every pending wake was seen. Current cursor files match the inherited report, but are not independently timestamped historical snapshots. No ownership, acknowledgement, retention or cursor state was changed by this audit. A cursor can also advance due to overflow eviction, so movement alone is not positive work evidence. Existing stalled status does not prove an out-of-band escalation succeeded during this incident.
